tips_en: Start with the Macaron-V1 paper (Paper 2) as it presents the most ambitious and broadly relevant contribution—a modular agent architecture whose frozen-base-plus-LoRA-specialist design conceptually mirrors the dynamic expert routing in SmartMage (Paper 3), and whose coding/agent evaluations are directly stress-tested by the multilingual refactoring benchmark in Paper 1. Together, the three papers sketch a coherent picture: Paper 1 diagnoses where current agents fail (cross-file coordination), Paper 2 offers an architectural remedy, and Paper 3 validates a similar modular-routing principle in a different modality.
tips_zh: 建议先阅读 Macaron-V1（论文 2），其"冻结基座 + LoRA 专家"的模块化设计与论文 3 SmartMage 的动态专家路由思想异曲同工，而其编码/智能体能力也可直接由论文 1 的多语言重构基准进行压力测试。三篇论文共同勾勒出一幅清晰图景：论文 1 诊断出现有智能体的短板（跨文件协同），论文 2 给出架构层面的解法，论文 3 则在另一模态上验证了类似的模块化路由原则。
